cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: an ancestral shrine hall with a bronze incense burner — kneeling on the ground; The wooden rigging deck of a community puppet theatre after a rehearsal — She mends a miniature moon prop with a strip of rice paper; an old Chengdu teahouse with bamboo chairs — holds her keepsake up beside her face; An open courtyard at a handmade paper mill — She holds a handmade sheet toward the sun and follows seven pale mulberry fibres with her free index finger; a small rural station with a wooden bench and a single platform — standing; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — kneeling on the ground; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; a backstage dressing room with a bulb-lit mirror — standing close to a high shelf or line; a narrow city alley with hanging signboards and wet pavement — standing; her tower bedchamber in a stone castle — holds a book closed against her chest; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — holds a microphone close to her lips; a themed costume event venue with props and a photo wall — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — lying on her left side
